_about: Styles for the deck-graphics plugin. Put this at your repo root; the scripts find it by walking up from the manifest. A style is a prompt preamble plus reference images (paths relative to this file) that the model is asked to match. Keys come from a .env beside this file: OPENROUTER_API_KEY, FAL_KEY, BRANDFETCH_CLIENT_ID.

prop.preamble: A single 3D object rendered in the material, lighting and camera of the reference images exactly, floating centered on a flat dark background. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people.

flat.preamble: Flat, minimal illustration on a dark background, one accent color, no gradients, no text, no watermark.
